children.html: Manta rays glide through JuJu’s Jackpot in a mesmerizing chain feed, mouths wide as they sweep through plankton-rich waters. This vibrant reef, named in honor of our first instructor Julie, offers front-row access to the magic of the deep. Keep an eye out for Polong, our mysterious resident manta with a dark back and striking white belly, a true icon beneath the surface.

children.html:
Ju-Ju’s Jackpot is not your average dive site. Beneath the surface lies a reef that feels alive at every turn. Bright anthias flicker like sparks of fire, reef sharks glide confidently along the edges, and black snappers twist and turn with the current. Just when you think it can’t get any better, manta rays drift into view. They move in perfect rhythm, mouths open as they scoop up plankton, passing gracefully overhead. The sight stops you in your tracks and fills you with that mix of adrenaline and awe that only the ocean can give.

Among them, one manta always stands out. His name is Polong, a rare black manta with a striking white mark on his belly. He has become something of a legend here, and once you see him, you understand why. There is a calm power in the way he moves, and his presence turns an incredible dive into an unforgettable memory. If you want to feel the ocean’s magic at its purest, Ju-Ju’s Jackpot will give it to you every single time.

Experience the thrill as manta rays take over Ju-Ju’s Jackpot, gliding in perfect harmony while filtering plankton with unmatched elegance and force. This isn’t just a dive, it’s a front-row seat to one of nature’s most incredible underwater performances.

Surrounded by vibrant coral and teeming marine life, you’ll feel the raw energy and beauty of the ocean up close. Watch the video to witness this breathtaking spectacle and get ready for an unforgettable adventure that will change how you see the sea forever.

children.html:
What is a ninja manta?

A ninja manta is a manta ray with an all-black or almost all-black body. Polong, a regular at Ju-Ju’s Jackpot, is black on top with a striking white mark on his belly.

Where is Ju-Ju's Jackpot?

Ju-Ju’s Jackpot is one of our West Sumbawa dive sites, named after Julie, our first instructor. Manta rays chain-feed there in plankton-rich water.

How do I dive with the mantas?

Join one of our guided boat dives (two-tank boat dives are IDR 2,200,000) and tell us you’d like to visit Ju-Ju’s Jackpot. Mantas are wild animals, so sightings depend on conditions and no dive is guaranteed.
